title: Release and adoption note
goal: Publish the minor release with an APPLY note so projects backfill `days` on open tasks
acceptance: CHANGELOG and APPLY: how to backfill `days` and `baselineDays` on open tasks (baseline = the current dated estimate, stated as a backfill)
privacy: Metadata only: estimates, dates, durations and task identities; no prompts, transcripts or personal data.
validation: Release checklist; check-harness --strict in a sample consumer

effort.basis: Same release path as v5.2.0. Estimate, not a measurement.

escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner (BACKLOG-RULES, "Optional upfront feature plans")
